question: Under what condition involving the tip of nectar and the tip of juice is even the wise person said to be burning?
premises: Reference is made to the tip of nectar.
Reference is made to the tip of juice as instrument.
Even the wise person is said to be burning.
This occurs in the condition indicated.
inference: Even the wise person, burning, does so in relation to the tip of nectar with the tip of juice.
uncertainties: Syntactic connection between the compounds and dahyamāna remains open
plain_english: Even the wise person, burning at the tip of nectar with the tip of juice.
